lines: yadvā jayema yadi vā no jayeyuḥ |
nāyaṁ bhūtvā bhavitā vā na bhūyaḥ |
yo yo yāṁ yāṁ tanuṁ bhaktaḥ
dhṛtiṁ na vindāmi śamaṁ ca viṣṇo ||24||
diśo na jāne na labhe ca śarma
droṇaṁ ca bhīṣmaṁ ca jayadrathaṁ ca
vettā'si vedyaṁ ca paraṁ ca dhāma
he kṛṣṇa he yādava he sakheti |
mā te vyathā mā ca vimūḍhabhāvaḥ
mukto yaḥ sa ca me priyaḥ ||15||
* This shloka is not universally found in all manuscripts, therefore no number has been assigned.
